title: Use pseudo elements to draw short decorative strips
goal: Use ::before and content to generate decorative boxes for titles.
summary: The title has text describing the status. Just add a purely decorative color mark next to it, without adding HTML content.
tasks: generates empty content for ::before of .notice-title, and uses inline-block to make a 6×16px rectangle.
short strip background #125a46, right margin 8px, keep the title text as it is.

example.note: content will also generate pseudo elements if it is an empty string. inline-block allows specifying dimensions on the same line.

hint: content: "" Generates a box that can be assigned a size and background color.
